## 6LU7: the main protease and the inhibitor N3

A crystal structure of the novel coronavirus's main protease (Mpro) with the inhibitor N3 covalently bound (Jin et al., 2020).

Contact residues are those where the distance between a protein atom $a$ and an inhibitor atom $l$

$$d_{al} = \lVert \mathbf{r}_a - \mathbf{r}_l \rVert$$

is $d_{al} \le d_c$ (cutoff of **pocket**, 4 Å by default). You can check that the catalytic His41 and Cys145 are among them.
